id: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone (2001)

facts.text: Sorry about the squashed birthday cake, Harry. It still tastes fine. Eat up, you've got a long term ahead.
facts.why: A loose paraphrase with invented extras. Hagrid's real line is ''fraid I might have sat on it at some point but I imagine it'll taste fine just the same.'
facts.fix: Sorry about the cake, Harry. I sat on it, but it'll taste fine just the same. Happy birthday.

fix_note.text: Sorry about the cake, Harry. I sat on it, but it'll taste fine just the same. Happy birthday.

facts.why: Rock cakes are a book detail. The film plot and quotes opened show none, so the name drops Hagrid and keeps the recipe.

vibe.verdict: The best looking of the lot, a proper Great Hall banquet with the trolley, the troll and the cupboard all there.
